description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external method references related to thread synchronization and locking mechanisms.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A class providing mutual exclusion lock functionality, wrapping platform-specific mutex mechanisms for thread synchronization.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class that allows one thread to access a resource at a time, with initial and maximum count controls.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore class that manages a count of available resources, supporting lock and unlock operations with timeout capabilities.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization primitive that can be set or reset, allowing threads to wait for or signal events.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template utility class that manages locking and unlocking of synchronization objects within a scope.
